name: qr-code
title: QR Code
description: A string as an SVG QR code, e.g. a link for a phone to scan: one path for all modules, crisp edges, a quiet zone of 4 modules, an error-correction level (M by default), a name for screen readers (never the value), and a caption under it. The plate stays white in the dark theme, as scanners need dark modules on a light plate. Made with uqr.
